notes:
Image generation accepts PNG, JPEG and WebP reference images, with model-specific limits, file verification and reference reuse on retry.
Apple Silicon Qwen-Image supports instruction edits with up to three input images and image-to-image redraw with adjustable strength; multiple base images run separately.
Image size choices follow each model: local MLX Qwen-Image offers 1K and 2K, while supported cloud models expose their available tiers. Local candle models remain 1K and do not accept input images.
Image generation clears the prompt and attachments after successful submission, preserves model settings, and retains inputs when submission fails.
ProRes and other QuickTime animations use compatible playback copies, preserving transparency where needed and keeping original media unchanged.
Imported legacy translations display in comparison and translation-only views as read-only content.
Legacy model caches can be recovered without replacing current settings or populated caches. Matching model bytes are reused across revision changes, and settings reports explain preferences that need reselection.
Windows Show in Folder converts extended drive and UNC paths to shell-compatible paths.
macOS MP4 finalization stays on the destination disk and export space checks reserve its temporary copy.
Audio export probes FFmpeg filter-script support directly instead of relying on help text, caches successful probes by environment, and retries failed probes. Probes wait for process completion without a separate timeout.
Speech provenance and agent job summaries omit absolute reference-audio paths.
Application update feeds include release notes. Verified Mac builds can publish while Windows builds continue.
Local Qwen image editing and 2K generation require Apple Silicon MLX and can use substantially more memory and time. Web reference selection uses Space entries.
macOS packages are signed and notarized. Windows CPU, CUDA and Vulkan packages are unsigned and require the Microsoft Visual C++ v14 x64 Redistributable.
